notes:
- **The Marketplace shows one tile for each job.** Where a job can be kept in more than one app, like
  your to-do list, its tile asks where it lives, and your agent uses one at a time. A job's extras
  are switches on its tile, and so are its routines. On your agent's Skills tab, each job is one row
  with the same switches.
- **Ask for something a switched-off extra does**, and the reply comes with a card to turn it on.
- **Six more apps: Cal.com, Granola, Otter, TickTick, Monarch Money and PayPal.** Booking Watch
  reads Cal.com or Calendly, Revenue Watch reads PayPal or Stripe, Meeting Notes asks Granola and
  Otter, your to-do list can be kept in TickTick, and your budget in Monarch Money.
- **Package Tracker's settings are yours.** Pick where it finds packages (your email, AfterShip or
  the Shop app), what it tells you about, and whether you hear right away or in one roundup a day.
- **Package Tracker can read your Shop orders** when you ask, once you connect Shop.
- **One computer at a time has your phone:** the one whose code you scanned last. Another computer
  on the same account steps aside and says so.
- **Text Replies keeps your rules in one box**, Anything else, and the replies it drafts follow
  them, as Email Manager's do. What you typed under When it writes as you is there now.
- Fixed: Archie Mobile could stop getting notifications when Archie runs on more than one of your
  computers.
- Fixed: the day before the clocks change, a daily routine showed its next run an hour off.
- Fixed: Morning Brief explained lists you never set up.
- Fixed: a personality that never uses emoji or exclamation marks could still send one.
